name: myledger
description: Personal financial tracker - Israeli bank/credit-card scraping, categorization and cash-flow dashboard
//dependencies: Versions are PINNED (no ^). Every runtime dependency here can read the credentials file, so an update is a deliberate, reviewed act - see SECURITY.md. Install with `npm ci`, never a bare `npm install`.

scripts.//postinstall: Prisma's generated client lives in node_modules, so `npm ci` wipes it and every Prisma type collapses to {}. Regenerating here is our own script, not a third-party install hook.
scripts.deploy:local: npm run typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:build && tsc && tsx scripts/deploy-local.ts
scripts.package:demo: npm run typecheck && npm run web:build && tsc && tsx scripts/package-demo.ts
scripts.//web:install: Must cd - `npm --prefix web install` treats the root package as a dependency and self-links it

//overrides: The scraper still requests Puppeteer 24, whose installer contains vulnerable extract-zip. Share our tested Puppeteer 25 instead. Prisma 6 config needs deepmerge-ts 8 for circular-reference safety. See SECURITY.md and dependency compatibility tests.
